info.title: Vortex Chess API
info.description: Authentication (milestone 1) plus private rooms, invitations, notifications and Socket.IO realtime (milestone 2). Bearer access JWT in frontend memory; rotating HttpOnly refresh cookie for /auth/refresh only. All responses use Cache-Control: no-store. Realtime events are documented in docs/Rooms_Invitations_Notifications_Milestone.md (Socket.IO path /api/socket.io). No email address of another account ever appears in these payloads. Email ownership is not verified; invitations bind to account ids, and email is only a lookup key and the offline delivery address. Participant-only finished-game history and isolated, temporary manual analysis are implemented; engine play/evaluation remain unavailable. See docs/History_Replay_Analysis_Milestone.md.

post.summary: Validate an untimed temporary variation from a recorded position
post.description: Participants only; game must be finished. Replays initialFen and recorded prefix up to basePly, checks SAN/FEN integrity, then applies the UCI path in an isolated chess.js instance. Returns every validated SAN/FEN plus final turn, check and legal destinations for the side to move. No writes, session table, clock changes, live events or engine calls. Earlier positions remain explorable after mate/resignation/timeout. FEN input and unknown fields are rejected. Do not automatically retry illegal moves.
